vectors.name: versioning_get_keys_request_version_two
vectors.description: Get Keys request for the public key at m/48'/0'/0'/2', but VERSION is 0x02 and three trailing bytes aabbcc follow the body. A version 1 parser reads the fields it knows and ignores the trailing bytes, so this must decode to the same message as get_keys_request_one_path.

vectors.name: versioning_address_uri_response_version_two
vectors.description: Address Verification ok response with URI bitcoin:bc1qxyz, VERSION 0x02 and three trailing bytes aabbcc. It must decode to the same message as address_verification_response_uri.
